name: Bling Blitz Power Nudge

features.name: Power Nudge
features.description: The middle reel can nudge to move a Collector into a winning position.

features.name: Collect Chests and Super Spins
features.description: Bronze, Silver and Gold Collectors award 1–3 Super Spins with multipliers up to 100x.

features.name: Prize Ladder
features.description: Three yellow diamonds climb a seven-level ladder, with a 1,000x Max Jackpot at the top.

review:
A three-reel collect game with four coloured chests above the grid. Coins, diamonds and crowned Collectors land below, and a nudge can shift the middle reel to drop a Collector into a winning spot.

Bronze, Silver and Gold Collectors give one, two or three Super Spins, diamonds can award five Bonus Super Spins, and three yellow diamonds move you up a seven-step Prize Ladder topped by a 1,000x Max Jackpot. Fun to watch – but the RTP is just 92.90%, well below average, with a 2,500x top multiplier. Definitely one to enjoy in demo.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
